text: つかまえた　ポケモンは　１０しゅるい　より　おおい　かな？

structure.jp: つかまえた　ポケモンは
１０しゅるい　より　おおい　かな？
structure.en: are they more than 10 kinds, I wonder?

patterns.name: 〜より
patterns.span: １０しゅるい　より　おおい
patterns.explanation: より means 'than' and comes after the thing you compare against. １０しゅるい　より　おおい = 'more than 10 kinds'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder', a gentle way of asking. おおい　かな = 'are there more, I wonder?'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a thing tells you which thing it is. つかまえた　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon you caught'.
